senses.gloss: निंस् €2 Ā. to touch closely, to salute, to kiss. निंस्ते दन्तच्छदं युवा Bk.

निनङ्क्षु a.
—1 Wishing to die.
—2 Wishing to escape or fly away; अपिस्फवच्च बन्धूनां निनङ्क्षुर्विक्रमं
 मुहुः Bk. 4. 33.

निनद् €1 P. —1 To sound, shout; मधुपटनिनदद्भिर्बोधितो राजहंसैः
 R. 5. 75; M. 5. 10; Bk. 6. 117.
—3 To resound, echo.

निन(ना)दः
—1 Sound, noise; U. 3. 7 (v. l.); उच्चचार निनदोऽम्भसि तस्याः R. 9. 73, 11. 15;
 Ṛs. 1. 15.
—2 Buzzing, humming (of bees &c.).
—3 A sound like that of a chariot; कर्णावपिगृह्य निनदमिव नदथुः
 Ch. Up. 3. 13. 8.

निन(ना)दः
—1 Sound, noise; U. 3. 7 (v. l.); उच्चचार निनदोऽम्भसि तस्याः R. 9. 73, 11. 15;
 Ṛs. 1. 15.
—2 Buzzing, humming (of bees &c.).
—3 A sound like that of a chariot; कर्णावपिगृह्य निनदमिव नदथुः
 Ch. Up. 3. 13. 8.
निनादित a. Filled with noise, resounding, made to sound.
निनादित + .{@-तम्@} A sound.

निनादिन् a.
—1 Sounding, ringing.
—2 Causing to sound, playing (as a musical instrument).
निनयनम् See under निनी.

—1 Performance.
—2 Performing, accomplishing.
—3 Pouring out.

निनर्द् €1 P.
—1 To sound.
—2 To prolong a note (in chanting).
निनर्दः Prolonging a note in chanting.
निनाह्यः A water-jar to be put into the ground.

निनी €1 P.
—1 To take near or towards, carry near, bring, fetch; चरितव्रत आयाते
 निनयेरन्नवं घटम् Y. 3. 295.
—2 To bend, incline; वक्त्रं निनीय.
—3 To pour down.
—4 To bring about, accomplish, perform.
—5 To spend (time).
निनृत्त a. Repeated (as a portion of a verse.)
निनृत्तिः f. Repetition.

निन्द् €1 P. (निन्दति, निन्दित; प्रणिन्दति) To blame, censure, find
 fault with, revile, reproach, condemn; निनिन्द रूपं हृदयेन पार्वती
 Ku. 5. 1; सा निन्दन्ती स्वानि भाग्यानि बाला Ś. 5. 30; Bg. 2. 36; Ms. 3. 42.
निन्दक a. [निन्द्-वुञ्] Blaming, censuring, abusing, defaming.

निन्दनम्, निन्दा [निन्द्-भावे-ल्युट् अ वा]
—1 Blame, censure, reproof, reproach, abuse, reviling, defamation; व्याजस्तुतिर्मुखे
 निन्दा K. P. 10; पर˚, वेद˚.
—2 Injury, wickedness.
.━{@Comp.@}: निन्दनोपमा, निन्दनस्तुतिः

निन्दनम्, निन्दा [निन्द्-भावे-ल्युट् अ वा]
—1 Blame, censure, reproof, reproach, abuse, reviling, defamation; व्याजस्तुतिर्मुखे
 निन्दा K. P. 10; पर˚, वेद˚.
—2 Injury, wickedness.
.━{@Comp.@}: निन्दनोपमा, निन्दनस्तुतिः
निन्दनम् + -उपमा a comparison which involves reproofs; Kāv. 2. 30.

निन्दनम् + -स्तुतिः f.
—1 ironical praise, irony.
—2 overt praise.

निन्दित p. p. [निन्द्-क्त]
—1 Blamed, censured, abused, defamed &c.
—2 Low, despicable.
—3 Prohibited, forbidden.

निन्द्य a.
—1 Blamable, censurable, reprehensible, bad, vile.
—2 Forbidden, prohibited.
निन्दतल a. Having a maimed hand.
निन्दुः f. A woman bearing a dead child.
